title: Homotopy inverse for increasing-tuple Cech restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a linearly ordered type, $U_i$ any family of opens of $X$ [def-sc-zariski-site], $F$ a presheaf of abelian groups, and $S$ chosen intersections with their universal properties [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Let $A$ be a nonnegative cochain complex of abelian groups with degree identifications $e_p:A^p\simeq\prod_{t:\operatorname{Fin}(p+1)\to I,\ t\text{ strictly increasing}}F(S.W(p,t))$. Let $r:S.\mathrm{complex}(F)\to A$ be a cochain map satisfying $e_p(r_p(s))_t=s_t$ for every increasing tuple $t$. Then there is a cochain map $i:A\to S.\mathrm{complex}(F)$ and homotopies $r\mathbin{\gg}i\simeq\mathrm{id}$ on the full complex and $i\mathbin{\gg}r\simeq\mathrm{id}$ on $A$.

proof.text: Apply the signed-extension section theorem to obtain i with i followed by r equal to identity.

Apply e to the component equation of i followed by r = identity. Using hr twice shows the increasing coordinates of r followed by i minus identity vanish. Apply the kernel-null-homotopy theorem, then Homotopy.equivSubZero to get the first homotopy. Homotopy.ofEq gives the second from the exact section equation.

lean.statement:
theorem alternatingCechRestrictionHomotopy (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type v} [LinearOrder I]
    (U : I → X.Opens) (F : X.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{w})
    (S : SiteCechComplex U (fun i ↦ homOfLE (le_top : U i ≤ ⊤)))
    (A : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{max v w} ℕ)
    (e : ∀ p : ℕ, A.X p ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of
      (∀ t : {t : Fin (p + 1) → I // StrictMono t}, F.obj (op (S.W p t.1))))
    (r : S.complex F ⟶ A)
    (hr : ∀ (p : ℕ) (s : S.cochains F p)
      (t : {t : Fin (p + 1) → I // StrictMono t}),
      (e p).hom ((r.f p) s) t = s t.1) :
    ∃ i : A ⟶ S.complex F,
      Nonempty (Homotopy (r ≫ i) (𝟙 (S.complex F))) ∧
      Nonempty (Homotopy (i ≫ r) (𝟙 A))
